question: Hello Oda-sensei! What was the content of the book that Nami and Toko were reading in chapter 1052? I'm curious, but I can already tell one thing - it's not something Sanji's interested in!
answer: Oh, you noticed them? It's a heartwarming scene. Nami loves to pore over the books she finds wherever they go. It looks like she found this in the library in the castle. I believe it's a fashion book about kimono. But Sanji's looking the other way. O: There were so many people who asked the question "what is Zoro's lineage?". I don't think there's anything to explain in the main story anymore, so I'll announce it here. O: The younger brother of Shimotsuki Furiko, who was on the ship that set sail from Wano, was none other than the "so-and-so" who met Yamato as a child, Shimotsuki Ushimaru, former daimyo of Ringo and the descendant of Wano's mythical samurai, Shimotsuki Ryuma, whom Zoro met back at Thriller Bark. In other words... what does that mean...?! It's a story of a very strange, twisted fate that even Zoro is unaware of.
name: Yu-kun
